CYCLE 5 — DETERMINANT REPLICA SEWING AND POSITIVE OVERLAY OBSTRUCTIONS
7 October 2026. Agent /root/gaussian_photonic.

STRONGEST RESULT / SCOPE

Three internally proved mechanism boundaries survive exact checks:

1. The equality-of-core-cut projector can annihilate a nonzero determinant
   replica tensor already at n=8. Thus no finite reverse norm bound can repair
   a proof that first replaces independent replica orientations by one common
   Pfaffian cut. A contractive projector alone is insufficient.
2. The hard-BCS ambient-hole signature is not always even-windable. In
   particular it has no exact nonnegative terminal-matching-circuit lift,
   regardless of the size of that lift.
3. For q independent four-site blocks, a positive decomposition into pairing
   orbits with one uniform global comparison loss requires loss >=2^q.
   A coefficientwise multiplicative K-approximation by an even-windable
   signature requires K>=2^(q/4). Ordinary Cauchy-Schwarz over amplitude
   orbit terms encounters precisely this exponential loss.

These are boundaries for explicitly defined proof/representation classes.
They do NOT refute an arbitrary additive Dirichlet-energy inequality, a
localized flow, a modified coordinate-auxiliary or replicated kernel, a
purification retaining mismatch registers, or a general hard-BCS FPRAS.
The independent-block instances themselves are easy to count and sample.
The general counting gate remains OPEN.

The separate aggregate leading-one exchange gate is now internally proved
in work/cycle5/stable_parity_exchange.txt. Its coefficient inequality is
consistent with every counterexample below. It does not evaluate those
coefficients or acquire a microscopic conditional exchange sampler.

INTERFACE

For an arbitrary rational matrix F (the obstructions use integers), let

 Z_R=sum_{I subset R, |I|=|R|/2} |det F[I,R\I]|^2

for even R, with Z_empty=1 and odd R assigned zero. On even ambient V define
f(U)=Z_(V\U). All costs of the explicit constructions below are polynomial:
the four-site tensor family has n=4q, O(q) entries in {0,+1,-1}, and input
length O(q) in sparse encoding. Its exponential lower bound is not caused
by a large numeric weight. The eight-site sewing counter has five unit
entries. No normalization, promise of nonzero minors, or phase oracle is
